_readme: The Hub's regions and languages (templates/regionalisation.md). A region sets units, currency, mains voltage, the codes an installer works to and the local Bromic site. Code names are the standard titles; every installation still goes to the local authority and a licensed installer, and the [[VERIFY]] notes ask a regional reviewer to confirm the current edition.

regions.label: US
regions.name: United States
regions.installer: a licensed electrician or gas fitter
regions.propane: 20 lb exchange cylinders or a bulk tank

regions.label: Canada
regions.name: Canada
regions.gas_code: CSA B149.1 (natural gas and propane installation code)
regions.installer: a licensed electrician or a licensed gas technician
regions.propane: 20 lb cylinders or a bulk tank
regions.verify: [[VERIFY: current CEC and B149.1 editions and provincial amendments — Sean (West Canada)]]

regions.label: AUS
regions.name: Australia
regions.installer: a licensed electrician or licensed gasfitter
regions.authority: your state or territory regulator and local council
regions.propane: LPG in 9 kg cylinders or larger bottles
regions.verify: [[VERIFY: current AS/NZS 3000 and 5601.1 editions — Bromic AU technical team]]

regions.label: NZ
regions.name: New Zealand
regions.electrical_code: AS/NZS 3000 (Wiring Rules), under the Electricity (Safety) Regulations 2010
regions.gas_code: AS/NZS 5601.1, under the Gas (Safety and Measurement) Regulations 2010
regions.installer: a registered electrician or registered gasfitter
regions.propane: LPG in 9 kg cylinders or larger bottles
regions.verify: [[VERIFY: New Zealand regulations, and whether NZ customers go to bromic.com.au or a NZ distributor — Bromic AU/NZ team]]

regions.label: UK
regions.name: United Kingdom
regions.gas_code: the Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998
regions.installer: a registered electrician or a Gas Safe registered engineer
regions.propane: LPG (propane) in 13 kg or 19 kg cylinders
regions.verify: [[VERIFY: current BS 7671 amendment and Part P notification for outdoor circuits — Bromic UK]]

regions.label: Benelux
regions.name: Belgium, Netherlands, Luxembourg
regions.installer: a qualified electrician or gas installer (in Belgium, with an AREI/RGIE inspection)
regions.propane: propane in 10.5 kg or 11 kg cylinders
regions.verify: [[VERIFY: current Dutch, Belgian and Luxembourg codes — Bromic Benelux distributor]]
regions.note: French (Belgium, Luxembourg) and Belgian-specific context are on hold (owner, 30 Oct 2026). Dutch is written for the Netherlands.

regions.label: Germany
regions.name: Germany
regions.installer: a registered electrician (Elektrofachbetrieb) or gas installer
regions.propane: propane in 5 kg or 11 kg cylinders
regions.verify: [[VERIFY: current VDE and DVGW rules for outdoor heaters — Raffaele Marti]]
